attchmntText: Mishra Dhatu Nigam Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Mishra Dhatu Nigam Limited held its Board of Directors meeting on November 11, 2026, to approve the Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company has scheduled a Q2FY27 results and Business Update Conference Call for Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 11:00 hrs India Time. The call will be represented by Dr. S. V. S. Narayana Murty, Chairman and Managing Director, Mrs. Madhubala Kalluri, Director Finance, and Mr. Padavittan Babu, Director P&M. Universal access numbers are +91 22 6280 1144 and +91 22 7115 8045. Toll-free numbers are available for Singapore, Hong Kong, UK, and USA. Registration is required via the provided Diamond Pass link. Contact details for the call coordinator and clarification are provided through ICICI Securities representatives.

attchmntText: Mishra Dhatu Nigam Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: MIDHANI published newspaper advertisements on November 13, 2026, in Financial Express, Hindi Milap, and Eendau. The ads contain extracts of financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. These results were approved by the Board of Directors. The company submitted this notice to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The filing is under Regulation 47 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The reference number is MDN/CS/COMPLIANCE/2026-27. The scrip code is 541195 and the trading symbol is MIDHANI. The letter was signed by the Company Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Mishra Dhatu Nigam Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the quarter and period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Mishra Dhatu Nigam Limited board meeting on November 11, 2026, approved un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The board took on record the re-appointment of Anjaneyulu and Co. as statutory auditors for the fiscal year 2026-27. Anjaneyulu and Co. were also appointed as tax auditors for the same period. The company noted the limited review report issued by the auditors on the financial results. The auditor confirmed that the interim financial information does not contain any material misstatement. Standalone profit before tax for the half-year was 19,953.01 lakh rupees. Consolidated profit for the period was 2,783.80 lakh rupees. Earnings per share for the half-year were 1.49 rupees.

attchmntText: Mishra Dhatu Nigam Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 27, 2026, titled "MIDHANI signs MoU with HWB and BARC for recovery of Nickel and Cobalt from plant reverts".
